block-comment.comment: Block comments nest (docs/spec/lexical-structure.md, Comments), so the rule includes itself.
block-comment.name: comment.block.zelkova

doc-comment.comment: `{-|` is an ordinary block comment to the compiler; the scope is only for themes.
doc-comment.name: comment.block.documentation.zelkova

strings.comment: Single-line only: a string unclosed at the end of its line ends there. The multi-line form is not implemented (LANG-79).
strings.name: string.quoted.double.zelkova

soft-keywords.comment: Each is a keyword in one position only (docs/spec/lexical-structure.md, Reserved words) and an ordinary identifier elsewhere. A TextMate grammar sees a line at a time, so each rule approximates the position by what is on the same line.

patterns.comment: left, right, non: the associativity of an infix declaration.
foreign: the header of a facade module.
unsafe: before a signature, `unsafe f : ...` or `unsafe (+) : ...`. `unsafe : ...` declares a constant called unsafe and is not matched.

derived: alone on an indented line (an instance body, or the request for a derived instance), or followed by one member name (a derivation in a class body). `derived = ...` and `derived : ...` are ordinary bindings and signatures. docs/spec/type-classes.md, An instance may be derived.

reserved-words.comment: Exactly the spec's Reserved words block; tests/editor_grammar.rs fails if the two drift. `true` and `false` are deliberately absent: the spec does not reserve them (LANG-1 tracks the tokenizer, which still does).
reserved-words.name: keyword.control.zelkova

not-yet-reserved-words.comment: docs/spec/type-classes.md reserves these when LANG-38 lands; they are highlighted ahead of the compiler. `where` is reserved only as a type variable and stays an ordinary identifier where a value is named, so a plain keyword scope over-highlights it there. tests/editor_grammar.rs names this list, and the allowance goes when LANG-38 adds the words to the spec's reserved list.
not-yet-reserved-words.name: keyword.control.zelkova

patterns.comment: Float: digits '.' digits with an optional exponent, or digits with an exponent.
patterns.name: constant.numeric.float.zelkova

patterns.comment: An uppercase name followed by a dot and a letter is a module qualifier: List.map, Maybe.Just.

operators.comment: A run of operator characters; `--` starts a comment, so no operator contains it.
operators.name: keyword.operator.zelkova
